Definition: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
BiblicalUsage: 1) apartness, holiness, sacredness, separateness; 1a) apartness, sacredness, holiness; 1a1) of God; 1a2) of places; 1a3) of things; 1b) set-apartness, separateness
